snippet.title: OAR'SOME ADVENTURES - New Game Announcement Trailer - WISHLIST NOW!
snippet.description:
Paddles up, Hosers! OAR'SOME ADVENTURES is a cozy/chaotic rafting and nature adventure for 1-8 players. Casually paddle your way down the river alone, or gather your friends for whitewater mischief and exploration in beautiful, yet dangerous, surroundings.
You can wishlist our game on Steam here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4555210/Oarsome_Adventures/

Join the official Haymaker Games discord to chat with others, get access to early playtests, and share your feedback with the devs!
https://discord.gg/ds92u6TajX

Follow Our Socials!
IG: https://www.instagram.com/haymaker_games/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@Haymaker_Games
Twitter: https://x.com/Haymaker_Games
